title: Machine-learned spectral PDE solvers for fluids and plasmas
abstract: arXiv:2610.27317v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse regression methods for discovering governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from data are sensitive to observation noise and are not constrained to reproduce the data under forward integration. We address both limitations by performing weak-form discovery in the spatial discretization in which the PDE is solved, learned by differentiating through multistep rollouts anchored at the observed states. The new method, Weak-form Anchored Rollout for PDEs (WARP), produces a machine-learned PDE solver. In this work, we focus on systems amenable to a spectral Galerkin solver. Across eight benchmark fluid and plasma systems, including high-dimensional turbulent simulations, WARP produces numerically stable rollouts from new random initial conditions and substantially improves coefficient recovery, rollout accuracy, and statistical measures compared with a single-step weak-form SINDy baseline.

translated_title: 面向流体与等离子体的机器学习谱方法偏微分方程求解器
translated_abstract: 用于从数据中发现控制偏微分方程（PDE）的稀疏回归方法对观测噪声敏感，且不受约束在正向积分下再现数据。我们通过在求解PDE所用的空间离散化中执行弱形式发现来克服这两个局限性，该方法通过在以观测状态为锚点的多步推演上进行微分来学习。新方法称为偏微分方程弱形式锚定推演（WARP），可产生机器学习的PDE求解器。在本工作中，我们聚焦于适合谱伽辽金（spectral Galerkin）求解器的系统。在八个基准流体与等离子体系统（包括高维湍流模拟）上，与单步弱形式SINDy基线相比，WARP能够从新的随机初始条件生成数值稳定的推演，并在系数恢复、推演精度和统计度量方面显著提升。
tldr: 提出WARP方法，通过在求解PDE的空间离散化中进行弱形式发现，并以观测状态为锚点的多步推演微分学习，构建出数值稳定的机器学习谱方法PDE求解器，在流体和等离子体基准系统上显著提升了系数恢复、推演精度和统计度量。
en_tdlr: WARP performs weak-form PDE discovery in the solver's spatial discretization, learned by differentiating through multistep rollouts anchored at observed states, yielding machine-learned spectral PDE solvers with numerically stable rollouts and substantially improved coefficient recovery and accuracy across eight fluid and plasma benchmarks.
